# Layout fixtures

These synthetic financial documents contain invented supplier and revenue data:

- `annual-report.pdf`: a two-page machine-text PDF with repeated headers.
- `pricing.pptx`: two slides with text and a native pricing table.
- `pricing.xlsx`: two sheets, a merged heading, and a formula without a cached value.
- `scanned-page.pdf`: an image-only page that must route to OCR.
- `image-slide.pptx`: a picture-only slide that must route to vision.

They are generated for and released with this repository; no external document
or customer data is included.
